inputs.text: [excited] Twenty-six feet long — [amazed] like two cars, one behind the other. Standing up, nine feet tall — [curious] as tall as a basketball hoop. And two thousand kilos — [proud] as heavy as a rhino.
[gasps] A rhino, for one of the very first ones?
[confident] Yep — [whispers] already a real giant, for its time.
